## Constitution Compliance Checklist (MANDATORY)

### Code Quality
- [ ] TypeScript strict mode enabled, no unjustified `any` types
- [ ] Components follow atomic design, single responsibility
- [ ] Co-located tests for all components/hooks/utilities
- [ ] Error handling with validation and graceful fallbacks

### Testing (≥90% Coverage Required)
- [ ] `npm test` passes all tests
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage` shows ≥90% coverage (statements, branches, functions, lines)
- [ ] Co-located test files exist for all new code
- [ ] Tests cover: happy path, edge cases, error states, null/undefined
- [ ] jest-axe accessibility tests included

### Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)
- [ ] All interactive elements keyboard accessible (Tab, Enter, Space)
- [ ] `aria-label` or visible labels on all inputs/buttons
- [ ] Color contrast meets 4.5:1 minimum (3:1 for large text)
- [ ] Visible focus indicators (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500`)
- [ ] Semantic HTML (proper heading hierarchy, button/input elements)
- [ ] Screen reader testing performed
- [ ] jest-axe tests pass

### Next.js 14 Patterns
- [ ] App Router structure used (no `pages/` directory)
- [ ] `'use client'` directive on client components
- [ ] Import aliases use `@/` prefix
- [ ] API routes use proper caching where applicable

### Pre-Merge Verification
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds (TypeScript compilation)
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] Manual testing on desktop and mobile viewports
- [ ] No `console.error` or `console.warn` in production code
- [ ] Code review completed
